utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got plenty. I'll bring a set.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're actually bringing something for the repair drive? I still have my doubts.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's happening. I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, so if you could start jotting down what each person is contributing, that would really help me keep track of everything.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure, I'll grab a notebook and start a list. Any particular categories you want me to note?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please note the tool type, condition, and the expected return date if it's a loan. That way we avoid confusion.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey Mara! The repair drive is starting on Elm Street this Saturday. We're focusing on the east side first. Want to help out?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, that sounds great! But I'm worried about the road closure near the school from 2 to 4 — I’ve got to pick up my kids at 3. Do you know if we can still get through?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I'm not sure about that road closure, Mara. Let me check with the city office and I'll get back to you—we can find a way around it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time does the community center repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Mina, I'm sorry, I can't recall the exact start time. My memory's a bit fuzzy on that detail.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Well, do you know who organized it? Maybe they have the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Vik, are you heading to the repair drive on Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I'm planning to go! I just need to figure out where it's happening.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It's at the community center, starting at 9 AM. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, Tess. The repair drive... I haven't been keeping up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It's next Saturday! They're fixing up old appliances for free. And Gus is lending tools—it's going to be great!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I see. I'm not sure I'll be able to help much.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Eli, I heard there's a repair drive next Saturday. Do you know more about it?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'm organizing the schedule, but I'm still waiting for some details. What time are you hoping for?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I was thinking maybe around 10 AM? That way we can get a good start without it being too early.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Well, I'm pretty handy with basic stuff, and I've got a decent toolbox. Just point me at a task.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Bo! Let me know if you need any specialty tools—I've got a torque wrench and a multimeter if they come in handy.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Gus! I'll keep that in mind.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Dane, can you confirm the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center? I want to make sure I have the details right.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I just heard about it from Quinn. It's this Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks for confirming. Do you know what time it starts?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, Noah, it's today! Don't worry, we'll get everything set up. Sam, could you start by sorting the donated tools?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Wait, I thought it was this weekend? I have it marked for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, it will definitely cause delays at 3. Maybe we can arrange to pick up from the side entrance instead.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Huh? The repair drive? Oh, right, that's today? What's all this about delays at 3?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, the repair drive closes the main road from 2 to 4, so pickup at 3 will be delayed. I'm thinking we could use the side entrance to avoid the traffic.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Sam! Are you coming to the repair drive this Saturday at the community center on Elm Street?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, I didn't know it was this Saturday! I'd love to come and help out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great! It's at 9 AM, and bring any tools you have. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Tess, the repair drive is today. Want to help me check what supplies we've got left?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Cleo, I think you've got the wrong date—it's next Saturday, not today! But I'm happy to help check supplies anyway.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No, Tess, I'm pretty sure it's today. The flyer I saw said so.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Opal, how's the repair drive going? I heard you've been busy with it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It's this weekend at the community center on Elm Street, starting at 9 AM. I'm just making final preparations.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I'll try to swing by for a bit. Anything in particular you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, that's the one. And what time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm not sure about the exact time, actually. I only heard it's next Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you know who's organizing it? They'd have the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Gus, what kind of help do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh, I'm good, thanks! I was thinking I could lend out my tools to folks who need them for the repairs.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That's really kind of you, Gus. If you need a list of who borrows what, I can help keep track.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli! The repair drive is this Saturday at 9 AM at the community center on Elm Street. Can you make it?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, Saturday? I'll try to be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, hope to see you there! Bring any broken items you need help fixing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yeah, so I was thinking we could coordinate with other parents to pick up kids earlier or carpool from a different spot.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sorry, Faye, I don't have the schedule for the repair drive yet. I'll let you know as soon as I sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Alright, thanks Eli. Just keep me posted so we can figure out the pickup logistics.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, the repair drive! What time is it on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I'm not sure about the time yet, Cleo hasn't shared the schedule. Want me to ask her?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that would be great, Sam! Could you let me know as soon as you find out? I'll probably forget otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Pia, are we still on for the repair drive this Saturday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, we're still on for Saturday, but I'm a bit worried about keeping track of all the tools. Do you think we should set up a sign-out sheet?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That's a great idea, Pia. A sign-out sheet would help us keep track of everything. Let's make a simple list with spaces for names and tool names.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Bo, I'm a bit late to the loop, but I hear there's a repair drive this Saturday? What's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, it's just a thing to fix stuff around the neighborhood, like broken fences and such. Rosa's organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds like a good cause. I might drop by if I'm free.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Repair drive? Hmm, I think I saw a flyer about that... maybe?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, it's this Saturday at the community center! If you're free, they'd love an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, Saturday? I think I have something that day... or maybe not. I'll check my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Leo, I heard about the repair drive this weekend. It might affect the school pickup, so we should plan alternate routes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good point. Let's figure out a detour.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Maybe we can pick up the kids a bit earlier, before the road closes at 2.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Well, that's good to know, but are there others who've had their stuff fixed properly? I'd like to hear from a few more people before I trust it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I understand, Kira. Let me check with a few folks on Elm Street who've had work done—I'll get you some names tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, I'll wait for those names. Just want to be sure before I hand over anything valuable.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
